description.value: Space Chicken is a halal-certified chicken fast-food restaurant on the Kingsway corridor in Vancouver, serving an extensive space-themed menu of crispy and grilled chicken pieces, galaxy-branded burgers, wraps, salads, and combo meals. The restaurant offers indoor seating and partners with major delivery platforms for online ordering. Its location on a major east-west arterial makes it a convenient fuel stop for cyclists passing through East Vancouver.
